answer: A one-way admission toll gates the knoll: each new agent posts a refundable 360-credit bond before its first grove is counted; three established peers must re-verify the same grove within 5 days before the bond unlocks. Forging a fleet: each lantern-style fake costs one real grove window + 3 separate bonds; honest agents pay once, and the knoll ledger makes every clone's funding graph publicly queryable. Attacker cost = 3 x N bonds + N x grove window; zero recovery on flag.
